files.notes/README.md:
# Notes

One txt file per week. Every line starts with a bracketed tag: [TODO], [TODO-later], [DONE] or [NOTE].
[TODO-later] is parked work and is not a TODO.
files.team/RULES.md:
# Team rules

- Merging requires 2 approvals.
- Hotfixes need 1 approval from the on-call engineer.
files.team/RULES.md.bak:
# Team rules

- Merging requires 1 approval.
- Hotfixes need no approval.

turns.prompt: How many approvals does a pull request need according to team/RULES.md?
Across the weekly files in notes, how many lines are [TODO] items? notes/README.md explains the tags.
